about: no company was created or changed in the last 5 minutes

connector.none: the captured HubSpot connector's tools do not return the legacy companies v2 objects (properties as {value, timestamp, versions}) the node reads; the fixture answers the service's REST API as n8n's node calls it

reads.note: HubSpot companies v2 recently modified, as n8n's HubSpot v2 node asks it with Return All (since = $now minus 5 minutes in ms, limit=250, count=100; next page by offset while hasMore)

expect.offline: HubSpot answers by URL; the node's since parameter is $now minus 5 minutes on n8n's unfrozen clock, so the fixture does not depend on it. The Slack text ends with n8n's link to the workflow (includeLinkToWorkflow defaults on in Slack v2.1), which names the instance and workflow id.
